facts.fact: Sandy 心里否定了 genius loci 的说法，认为 Round Robin 更像 bogeyman
facts.anchor: But they did not think, from Percival’s description, that Round Robin sounded like a genius loci at all. They thought it sounded more like a bogeyman.

facts.fact: Sandy 拉开三层楼天花板的绳结，放下久未使用的折叠梯
facts.anchor: Sandy stood on tiptoes, grabbed the knot, and gave it a firm pull; the hatch creaked open and a long-disused accordion ladder unfolded

facts.fact: 开灯受惊后 Sandy 从梯子滑下摔到木地板上
facts.anchor: Sandy shrieked and shimmied down the ladder, missed the last rung and tumbled, hitting the wooden floor with enough force to see a burst of stars.

facts.fact: Sandy 二次上梯前念了女巫保护祷词
facts.anchor: Witch mother, witch father, I pray thee give thy child protection as they go forth in this treacherous world. So mote it be.

facts.fact: Sandy 推开没有把手的暗门
facts.anchor: It had no knob, but Sandy pressed upon it with one hand and it swung open without even a token resistance.

facts.fact: 暗门后房间里的摇篮床垫仍留着小小身体压出的凹陷
facts.anchor: The cradle’s thin mattress still retained the depression of a small, small body.

facts.fact: 写字台上的剥制野兔压着一本皮面书 H. Hollyoak
facts.anchor: On the rolltop desk, there was a poorly taxidermized hare, desiccated and lean, with insane staring eyes of yellow glass, its buckteeth bared in a frozen snarl. It was propped upon a thick book, bound in leather soft as a lover’s lips, with the title H. Hollyoak.

facts.fact: 章末 Mom 把娃娃搁在野兔标本旁，要 Sandy 别再犯傻
facts.anchor: Mom placed the doll upon the surface of the rolltop desk, propping it against the taxidermized hare. “You know I support you, Sandy, but you need to stop being silly. Not everything needs to be a lecture.”
